en: \bBea uses Fighting type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Flying, Psychic, and Fairy types.
it: \bFabia usa Pokémon di tipo Lotta. Sono deboli contro i tipi Volante, Psico e Folletto.

en: \bDon't blame me if you get hurt.

en: \bThe bear I had? Mind your buisness.

en: \bWe take training here seriously. You won't catch us slaking off like that Ghost Gym.
